messages:
sara: Heads-up: experimenting with a "budgeted fallback" routing mode today — cheaper model variants for low-tier, plus a per-request token-cost cap. @marta @oliver any quick thoughts?

marta: quick q — do you want budget expressed as per-request `max_token_cost` or tenant-level rolling budget (or both)?

sara: planning both: a per-request `max_token_cost` + tenant-level `monthly_budget_units`. API snippet I mocked: 
```
routing:
  tier: standard
  budget:
    per_request_max_cost_usd: 0.002
    tenant_monthly_units: 1000000
```

oliver: agree. also need to define routing ordering: cheap-variant-first vs local-high-perf-first. it's a latency vs $ tradeoff. propose a combined score: `score = latency_penalty * w1 + cost_per_token * w2 + tier_penalty`.

kevin: concrete suggestion for weights so sim team can run numbers: `score = (latency_ms/100)*0.3 + (cost_per_token/0.001)*0.6 - tier_bonus` (lower is better). we can tune w1/w2 per-customer type.

marta: UX note — console should surface `expected_token_cost` before routing decision + a toggle `allow_auto_degrade` with a slider for max allowed quality drop (e.g., 0-20%). PM wants a simple default on.

sara: telemetry reqs: sample every routing decision (sample rate configurable), include: `route.choice`, `candidate_scores`, `model_variant`, `tokens_out`, `estimated_cost_usd`, `budget_state`. retention 90d for aggregated, 7d for full decision logs. metric names: `routing.decision`, `routing.budget_hit`, `routing.rollback_signal`.

deploy-bot: rollout started: econ-routing-v1 canary -> 5% traffic (strategy=percent, duration=30m)

oliver: keep canary small and add synthetic probes hitting the heavy prompts in our eval set. if budget_hit_rate > 1% for 2h => automatic rollback. Also add a slow-path latency probe to avoid bad tail increases.

kevin: API implementation note — when we reserve budget for a request we need idempotency keys + a short-lived reservation token so retries don't double-charge budget. add `X-Budget-Reservation` header.

marta: sounds good. I'll sketch the console tile + alert thresholds. also want a debug panel that shows recent decisions per-tenant (searchable).

sara: yep. planning an internal endpoint for the debug view: `/api/internal/tenant/{tenant_id}/routing_decisions` (auth-only). will also expose aggregated metrics in the tenant dashboard.

oliver: small nit — name the per-request field `max_token_cost_usd` to be explicit.

sara: done. I'll open a PR with the routing schema, telemetry events, and a sim harness for 3 workloads. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
